notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds (incl. School Nutrition and Activities) shown as governmental funds, so no business-type section. Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p3). Beginning cash = total fund balances beginning of year (cash basis); ending 7,143,446 = cash 6,087,017 + county treasurer 1,056,429 (p4). Interfund transfers 100,000 net to zero in the total column, so transfers_in/out are null. Student support services 1,114,965 split into General Fund + Student Fee support services 696,392 and Activities Fund 418,573 (student activities) using p6. Other receipts 2,445 split by General Fund schedule p7; Other 26,990 split into sale of assets 4,603 and remainder 22,387 (GF nonrevenue 1,083 + other fund items). State receipts kept as one line (includes property tax credit, homestead, special ed, aid). Public power district sales tax categorized as other taxes. Hidden transfer: General Fund O&M lines include a 350,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (p5 Reclassification column eliminates it from O&M and from transfers; Depreciation fund shows 350,000 transfer in p12): recorded as contra line -350,000 in expenditure (O&M) plus other financing -350,000, GF detail total 8,174,744 (includes the 100,000 Activities Fund support and the 350,000 transfer). Only the General Fund budget schedule (p7-10) is used for General Fund detail (by program; no object-level Exhibit N present); the p5 combining page was used only for the transfer. Function headings' budget amounts (e.g. 1000 Instruction 4,282,838) not attached to lines. Federal programs and state categorical lines categorized as instruction per p5 reclassification into Instruction. Ending cash identity: 7,345,366 + 9,962,783 - 10,164,703 = 7,143,446.
